The story behind the journey

What if one little idea could bring us together?

I'm Dolphintouch, a newcomer to geocaching from Hervey Bay in Queensland, Australia. After watching Robson Green go geocaching in a YouTube video, I was inspired to try it for myself.

Then a thought came to me: what if I sent six trackables travelling around the world, inspired by the idea of Six Degrees of Kevin Bacon?

The familiar game links actors through their film connections. My version is a little broader: music, movies, people, places, stories, and those unexpected moments when one life touches another.

“Perhaps, just perhaps, one of these little travellers might even reach Kevin Bacon himself.”

But the bigger hope is to show that, even in uncertain times, strangers can come together through curiosity, peace and kindness. The journey matters more than the destination.

With love, Dolphintouch ♡
Small tokens.
Big adventures.

The journey so far

Real stories shared by the geocachers carrying the challenge forward. Tap a place on the map, or choose a region below, to explore the adventures.

An illustrated map of places featured in participants' logs, not a live tracker or an exact travel route. Updated from shared logs through 15 November 2026.

22 October 2026

It begins in Hervey Bay

Small parcels of trackables and kindness leave Queensland with the help of overseas volunteers. The dream of a worldwide challenge starts to take shape.

📍 Hervey Bay · Queensland, Australia
27 October 2026

Welcome to the UK, Kevin!

Geocacher RTM1974 welcomes Kevin to Carlisle, Cumbria, then shares a trip to Gretna Green. The adventure has crossed an ocean!

📍 Carlisle & Gretna Green · UK
30–31 October 2026

Lakes, stories and scenery

From Windermere to a beautiful view at a cache dating back to 2005, the UK hosts share the landscapes, history and little moments encountered along the way.

📍 Lake District · England
6 November 2026

Kevin reaches Georgia

Beastee logs Kevin's arrival in Augusta, Georgia, ready for a fresh chapter of adventures across the United States.

📍 Augusta · Georgia, USA
9 November 2026

A visit to another state

Beastee takes Kevin to South Carolina, sharing another stop and another photograph for the growing collection of stories.

📍 South Carolina · USA
12 November 2026

Discovering the connections

In Evans, Georgia, Beastee's log explores local connections to musicians Josh and Charles Kelley and actress Gilland Jones. This is the spirit of the challenge!

📍 Evans · Georgia, USA

And it keeps going: other logs also show geocachers, including ms_sammii, taking trackables along to cache visits and maintenance outings in November. Every stop and shared story counts. ♡

You can be part of the story

Help the next connection happen.

You don't have to meet a celebrity or visit somewhere famous. A local landmark, a song, a film connection, a beautiful view or a simple act of kindness can all help tell the story.

01

Find a traveller

Come across one of the challenge trackables during a geocaching adventure.

02

Log your visit

Use the code on the physical trackable to log it correctly through Geocaching.

03

Share your connection

Add a photo or tell us about a landmark, movie, musician, person or place you discovered.

04

Pass the kindness on

Move the trackable to another suitable cache and let someone else continue its story.

Where might the next tag go? Somewhere across the ocean, into a new friendship, or perhaps even all the way to Kevin Bacon himself.
